svg.title: DCP: each MLA token is stored on one GPU instead of all eight
svg.desc: MLA keeps one latent KV entry per token that every attention head reads, so TP8 alone stores the same KV on all eight GPUs. DCP8 deals the tokens round-robin, token i to GPU i mod 8, so each GPU stores one-eighth. In each decode step every GPU computes all query heads locally, attends over its own tokens, and one all-to-all per MLA layer merges the eight partial results.
svg.text: DCP: each MLA token is stored on one GPU instead of all eight
One sequence, token positions 0–15 shown · MLA layers only · KDA state stays TP-local
token i is stored on GPU i mod 8
each GPU keeps 1/8 of the KV
Each MLA layer with DCP8 adds one all-to-all per decode step
all heads computed on every GPU
each GPU over its own tokens
